title: Hearth of Steel
shortDescription: Anvils and hanging mail keep the room honest.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Steel is an armory that still remembers it is a classroom. Anvils sit where first-years will learn not to lean. Mail hangs in a neat row. Practice swords wait on a rack that has been oiled more often than it has been praised.
Mentor Edge keeps the floor clear and the excuses shorter than the lesson.

fixtures.name: Mentor Edge
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred hare in a mail shirt, one ear notched, a practice sword at the hip. Try talk edge.
fixtures.examineDescription: Edge's notch is newer than Flint's and just as earned. The mail is mended. He treats a sloppy stance as a kindness you have not yet been given.
fixtures.dialogue: "Steel is a craft of meeting what comes. Look this hearth. Find Flint. Come back."

welcome.text: "I am Edge. Steel teaches you to meet what comes. Look this hearth. Walk to the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Return and talk to me."

craft.text: "A blade that is only shown is furniture. First you look. Then you practice on Flint's dummy. Then you come back, and we will see if your feet remembered."

go.text: "Look the anvil. Then find the orchard. I will be here."

fixtures.name: Practice Anvil
fixtures.examineDescription: The face of the anvil is bright from use. A rack of practice blades waits, oiled and unromantic. A slate says: 'Name the stance before you swing.'
